notes: Typemill 2.28.2 (flat-file PHP CMS, Slim + Vue admin). Runtime: static FrankenPHP 1.13.5 binary (PHP 8.5.12 with gd/mbstring/fileinfo/session/iconv) and Composer 2.11.2, both pinned via mise http: backends in mise.toml. Composer deps were installed into system/vendor from composer.lock (dist URLs pointed to codeload.github.com because api.github.com is blocked; lock file left unchanged). start.sh runs `frankenphp php-server` (front-controller fallback to index.php) on PORT plus the service stub on 4492. The admin account was created through the real /tm/setup form; then .ui-capture/seed/seed.sh -> seed.php writes Typemill's own storage format (content/*.md published, *.txt draft blocks, *.yaml meta; settings/users/*.yaml; settings/settings.yaml; media/original|live|thumbs). Re-run `.ui-capture/seed/seed.sh` to regenerate (it wipes content/). Data: 'Ledgerline Help Center', the help center of a fictional invoicing and bookkeeping SaaS, maintained since Feb 2025. 96 content items in 10 sections (Getting Started, Invoicing, Expenses, Banking with a nested Bank feeds folder, Taxes, Payroll (beta), Reports, Integrations, Account & billing, and Release Notes as a posts folder with 21 releases from 2025-03 to 2026-10 plus an unpublished 4.13 draft) and a hidden, editor-restricted Internal folder. Status mix: 86 published, 5 modified (published with pending draft edits, orange in the navigation), 4 unpublished drafts (red), 1 hidden page, 1 member-restricted page (REST API), and 1 301 redirect (Billing FAQ). Created/modified dates are spread from 2025-02 to 2026-11 across 7 authors. 9 users across all roles (administrator dkowalski, manager skimura, editor jmensah, authors priyanair/tbrzezinski/aberg, contributors lfernandez/mokafor, member rholloway) with last-login times. Media: 9 generated screenshot-style PNGs (embedded in pages, plus hero images on release posts), one CSV in media/files, and the stock demo webp. Main areas: frontend site at /, editor at /tm/content/visual/<page> (visual) and /tm/content/raw/<page> (raw), with the page tree on the left, the publish bar and the meta tab; /tm/system (settings), /tm/themes, /tm/plugins, /tm/users (user list, filter by role), /tm/account.
